visaHelp.title: Residence status (visa) guide
visaHelp.intro: Choose the code shown in the residence-status field on your alien registration card.
visaHelp.checkCard: You can confirm your exact status on your alien registration card or through Hi Korea.

visas.F-6: Residence status for a marriage migrant married to a Korean citizen.
visas.F-4: Residence status for an overseas Korean who holds foreign nationality.
visas.F-5: Permanent residence status without a fixed limit on the period of stay.
visas.F-2: Residence status for people who meet the requirements for long-term residence in Korea.
visas.E-9: Residence status for foreign workers employed in non-professional occupations.
visas.H-2: Residence status allowing eligible overseas Koreans to visit and work in Korea.
visas.D-2: Residence status for students attending a Korean university or educational institution.
visas.OTHER: Choose this if none of the listed types applies or if you are unsure of your status.
